headline: How a Jet Fuel Refinery Is Scrambling After the Iran War Oil Shock
context: For a mega-refinery in Ulsan, South Korea, a top exporter of jet fuel to the West Coast of the United States and other places, weaning off Middle Eastern oil is no small feat.
